verdict.rationale: Weave documents a programmatic Evaluation object built on a Dataset. Its MCP server and Skills let coding agents run evaluations and answer questions about evaluation results, and a REST Service API offers programmatic access. However, no evidence shows an agent itself creating and publishing a dataset end-to-end, and the read-back of eval results is described only at a high level. missing for 10: explicit documentation of agent-driven dataset creation/publishing, concrete API or MCP tool reference for triggering an eval and retrieving its scores, independent or hands-on corroboration of the full agent loop.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent create a dataset, trigger an eval run programmatically, and read back the results

citations.quote: the core of the workflow is the _`Evaluation` object_, which defines: A `Dataset` or list of dictionaries for test examples. One or more scoring functions.
